summary: Evotec SE filed a 6-K announcing a new nomination to its Supervisory Board alongside a cooperation agreement with activist shareholder MAK Capital. Dr. Wolfgang Hofmann is nominated as an independent board member; the AGM will also vote on Dieter Weinand as Chair and a board expansion from six to seven members. MAK Capital agreed to customary voting and cooperation commitments. The filing reflects a board refresh and activist settlement, not a routine circular. Watch for AGM vote outcome on June 11, 2026, and continued shareholder engagement.
